  The Qing list of the gates of 圆明园 and of its three sluices, to set against the labels of S01.
- **E0386** (text, likely): 五空出水閘 and 一空出水閘: where they stand. 1780s · j80:7a-7b · S05. https://github.com/kanripo/KR2k0036/blob/master/KR2k0036_080.txt
  > 圓明園之水發源玉泉山由西馬厰入進水閘支流派衍至園內日天琳宇桞浪聞鶯諸處之響水口水勢遂分西北高而東南低五空出水閘在明春門北一空出水閘在蘂珠宫北水出苑牆經長春園出七空閘東入清河
  Water comes in from the north-west and leaves on the east: the five-arch sluice stands north of 明春门, the one-arch sluice north of 蕊珠宫; it goes on through 长春园 to 七空闸 and the 清河.
- **E0387** (text, likely): 明春门 from the 长春园 side. 1780s · j83:12a · S05. https://github.com/kanripo/KR2k0036/blob/master/KR2k0036_083.txt
  > 流香渚之西循山逕行即逹圓明園之明春門
  West of 流香渚 a hill path comes to 明春门 of 圆明园.
- **E0381** (text, likely): 玉明 侍游御園記: the gates on his route, 1856. 咸豐六年七月二十一日 1856 · 蕉軒隨錄, 御園侍游 · S210. https://github.com/garychowcmu/daizhigev20/blob/master/史藏/志存记录/蕉轩随录.txt
  > 午初一刻进西南门……过蕊珠宫门，至黄花磴进茶毕……由宝相寺、法慧寺、谐奇趣过明春门，至雷峰夕照马头……进丽春门骑马，由旧园东墙根过敷春堂，游西大堤汉城关，至含辉楼下马
  A guard officer's route: in by 西南门, past 蕊珠宫门 to the European palaces, back by 明春门 to 福海, in by 丽春门, along the old wall past 敷春堂. Shows the name 敷春堂 in use in 1856, and 丽春门 (not yet tied to a plan label). The rest of this passage has its own entry.
- **E0388** (description, likely): 明春门 (圆明园百景图志, by S111). 2017 blog, on the Yuanmingyuan archive · section 涵虚朗鉴 · S111. https://blog.sina.com.cn/s/blog_88741e0d0102x6gc.html
  Past the south of 雷峰夕照 to the east lies 明春门: plaque of 1749, called the main gate for the Emperor's trips to 长春园; store rooms on the hill to its north repaired in 1791.
- **E0389** (description, likely): 围墙 and gates between the three gardens (S57 = S116). 2021, on Yangshi Lei wall plans · section 1.2, 3.3 · S57. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202108/t20210831_4483376.html
  Between 圆明园 and 长春园: 明春门, 绿油门, 蕊珠门. Between 绮春园 and 长春园: 茜园门. Between 绮春园 and 圆明园: 秀清村门. Today's wall file names 藻园门, 西爽村门, 运料门, 绿油门, 福缘门 and 东楼门 as sites of wall gates, 西北门 and 大北门 by their walls. 绿油门 is not labelled on S01.

**On the plan:** Drawn as a gate on the plan of the gardens (S01). https://artmuseum.princeton.edu/collections/objects/138657
